propositions: Container tickets with empty own file_impact fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation, forcing re-review on every commit regardless of relevance, because their signed dependency set is empty.
A container's plan-review scope should inherit from its non-closed direct children's declared file_impact union, but only when all non-closed children declare non-empty impact (poison rule).

The orchestrator already fetches direct children's status and file_impact in assembled context; this data must be threaded through sign_plan_review → dependency_hashes to compute inherited scope without new store reads.
Closed children contribute neither files to the inherited union nor poison it, because their work is delivered and belongs to other tickets per ADR 0024.

P9 must surface an advisory (non-blocking) when a container's inheritance is poisoned by non-closed children lacking file_impact, naming those children so authors understand why the epic remains on whole-HEAD invalidation.
Child file_impact edits must invalidate the container attestation via material fingerprint drift (existing pin lattice), ensuring inherited scope cannot silently go stale.
